channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mitch Kupchak | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mitch Kupchak from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kai Jones on Mitch Kupchak
item.description:
Kai Jones:

“Mitch Kupchak, he believed in me from the first day. He told me that he really thought I was going to be a great player in the NBA. And even when I was waived and a free agent, I called him up and I said, Mitch, thank you for everything you did for me. And he told me, I still think you have a chance to come back into the NBA and be a great player. And I think that I did, showing my preseason with the Clippers and my time with the Clippers and the Mavs. I think that I showed that I can really play at a high level in the NBA and help a team win.”

Kai Jones on Mitch Kupchak, Jul 8, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Mitch Kupchak, Josh Howard, Jerry Buss, Jason Terry
item.description:
Mark Cuban:

“You know how close we were to trading for Kobe in 2007. Oh my God, it was like literally this close. I talked to Jerry Buss and worked something out. Kobe wanted to leave. Jerry said, 'if you want to leave, we'll take care of it.'We were going to trade Josh Howard, Jason Terry, and picks, but no Dirk. I said, ‘Anyone but Dirk.’ Kobe wanted it, and Jerry was willing to do it, but Mitch Kupchak talked Jerry out of it. It was going to happen. I remember telling this dude,’ I’m like, ‘Kobe’s going to be a Mav,’ and I thought it was done. But Mitch Kupchack stepped in, and that’s how it fell apart. The rest is history.”

Mark Cuban on Mitch Kupchak, Josh Howard, Jerry Buss, Jason Terry, Oct 10, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kai Jones on Mitch Kupchak
item.description:
When the Hornets subsequently asked him not to report to training camp, he recognized that his days with the franchise were likely numbered and requested a trade.

“(Hornets general manager) Mitch (Kupchak) tells me I’m not allowed to do training camp,”

Kai Jones on Mitch Kupchak, Nov 24, 2023. Source: Hoops Rumors.

item.title: James Borrego on Mitch Kupchak, Buzz Peterson
item.description:
Rod Boone:As for #Hornets possibly bringing someone in, James Borrego said:

“I know he (Mitch Kupchak) is looking into it and we're doing our homework. If there is someone that fits and it makes sense, I know Mitch and Buzz (Peterson) are all about doing what's best for our team.”

James Borrego on Mitch Kupchak, Buzz Peterson, Dec 24, 2020. Source: Twitter @rodboone.

item.title: Julius Randle on Mitch Kupchak
item.description:
“You grow up idolizing somebody you don’t really know what to expect when you first meet him. It was everything I expected and more. It’s crazy. The GM here [with the Hornets], Mitch Kupchak, was my GM in L.A.. He always used to tell me, watch everything that he does. That’s exactly what I did. I watched his every move. I could go on forever what I can take from him and learn from him. For me, I’m just going to — just pray for his family. It’s not about me. He has three beautiful daughters that he has, a lovely caring wife. There are a bunch of families involved for such a tragic tragic thing.”

Julius Randle on Mitch Kupchak, Jan 29, 2020. Source: Newsday.

item.title: Brandon Bass on Byron Scott, Mitch Kupchak
item.description:
Mark Medina:Brandon Bass:

“Mitch [Kupchak] and Coach Scott did a great job in putting the young guys out there.”

Brandon Bass on Byron Scott, Mitch Kupchak, Apr 14, 2016. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Roy Williams on Mitch Kupchak
item.description:
Williams said on FOX Sports Radio on Wednesday.

“(Lakers general manager)Mitch Kupchak is one of my best friends in the whole wide world, there's no question there, but I'm a college guy and if somebody calls and offers me the greatest job in the world, it better be really good because I feel like I've got about the greatest job in the world.”

Roy Williams on Mitch Kupchak, May 8, 2014. Source: Chicago Tribune.

item.title: Roy Williams on Mitch Kupchak
item.description:
The Lakers’ general manager Mitch Kupchak is a UNC graduate who has a close relationship with Williams.

“Mitch Kupchak is one of my best friends in the whole wide world, there’s no question there. But I’m a college guy,”

Roy Williams on Mitch Kupchak, May 8, 2014. Source: Wilmington NC News.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Mitch Kupchak
item.description:
“I told [General Manager] Mitch Kupchak that last week. First they have to make up their mind on who they want, and then they tell me, just like I recruited Ron Artest, I talked to Lamar Odom.”

Magic Johnson on Mitch Kupchak, Feb 6, 2014. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Phil Jackson, Mitch Kupchak, Lester Conner
item.description:
Conner asked Shaw if the Lakers could use Vogel as an advance scout on the East Coast.

“Sight unseen, just off of Lester’s word, I went to (Lakers general manager) Mitch Kupchak and (coach) Phil Jackson and said, ‘Can we think about hiring this guy?’ For $200 a game, he scouted all our East Coast opponents. That kept him involved, kept his name out there and so he always reminds me, ‘You threw me a lifeline and I threw you one.’ It worked out well.”

Frank Vogel on Phil Jackson, Mitch Kupchak, Lester Conner, Jan 26, 2014. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Mitch Kupchak
item.description:
“The question is, is (general manager) Mitch Kupchak going to round this thing out or is he going to do the Danny Ainge thing and just say, 'You know what? We'll just blow this thing up and prepare for the future.' That's the real big question.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Mitch Kupchak, Jul 11, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Dwight Howard on Mitch Kupchak
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:Dwight on Kupchak:

“Mitch is a really good human being and I respect him. So, it was very tough to sit on the phone and talk to him”

Dwight Howard on Mitch Kupchak, Jul 6, 2013. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Phil Jackson on Mitch Kupchak
item.description:
Naturally Jackson wanted Brian Shaw to take over for him after he left the Lakers in 2011 but the team went with Mike Brown, and then, after a brief flirtation with Jackson, chose Mike D'Antoni.

“I sat with [Lakers General Manager] Mitch Kupchak a week ago and even he couldn't find out for me,”

Phil Jackson on Mitch Kupchak, Jun 13, 2013. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Mitch Kupchak, Jeanie Buss
item.description:
Should the Lakers resort to a Plan B if Howard walks, Bryant says he will make his voice part of the process.

“It's gotten to a point at this stage in my career where those lines of communication are more open and we talk more frequently both with (general manager) Mitch (Kupchak) and (vice president of player personnel) Jimmy (Buss) and (vice president of business operations) Jeanie (Buss) to a certain extent,”

Kobe Bryant on Mitch Kupchak, Jeanie Buss, Jun 3, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Mike Brown on Mitch Kupchak
item.description:
“It's their team. They have every right to do what they want to do with it. You know, I appreciate the opportunity that they gave me, and it was a decision that the Busses and Mitch Kupchak came to. They felt they would be better going in another direction. So from that standpoint I respect it, I appreciate the opportunity, but it was a little surprising.”

Mike Brown on Mitch Kupchak, Feb 14, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Mike Brown on Mitch Kupchak
item.description:
About the Lakers firing him, Brown said:

“I appreciate the opportunity that the Buss family gave me and Mitch Kupchak gave me. Coaching the Lakers was an exciting, great time. It was a dream job for a lot of people, including myself. And it’s their team and so whenever, however they wanted to operate it I was okay with. It’s not my decision to talk about the decision that they made. I just live by whatever decision they make.”

Mike Brown on Mitch Kupchak, Dec 14, 2012. Source: Orange County Register.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Mitch Kupchak, Mike D'Antoni, Jim Buss
item.description:
Of course, Bryant said Tuesday that he didn’t know Jackson was interested in the job.

“I told them (General Manager Mitch Kupchak and Jim Buss) Mike D’Antoni was my first choice,”

Kobe Bryant on Mitch Kupchak, Mike D'Antoni, Jim Buss, Nov 13, 2012. Source: Orange County Register.

item.title: Phil Jackson on Mitch Kupchak, Jim Buss
item.description:
“Saturday morning, [Lakers executive] Jim Buss called to ask if he could come and visit. I didn't solicit or ask for the opportunity but I welcomed both him and [team executive] Mitch Kupchak into my home to discuss the possibility of my return to the Lakers as head coach,”

Phil Jackson on Mitch Kupchak, Jim Buss, Nov 13, 2012. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Phil Jackson on Mitch Kupchak, Mike D'Antoni
item.description:
“We talked for over an hour and a half. No contractual terms were discussed and we concluded with a handshake and an understanding that I would have until Monday [today] to come back to them with my decision. I did convey to them that I did have the confidence that I could do the job. I was awakened at midnight Sunday by a phone call from Mitch Kupchak. He told me that the Lakers had signed Mike D'Antoni to a three-year agreement and that they felt he was the best coach for the team. The decision is of course theirs to make. I am gratified by the groundswell of support from the Laker fans who encouraged my return and it is the principal reason why I considered the possibility.”

Phil Jackson on Mitch Kupchak, Mike D'Antoni, Nov 13, 2012. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Ettore Messina on Mitch Kupchak
item.description:
Messina spent the season in NBA with the Lakers as special assistant coach of Mike Brown.

“Mitch Kupchak called me telling me: 'I've heard just great things on you and I've seen you at work. We would love to have you back with us next season'. It was a big pleasure for me. But I haven't decided yet. I have good offers from Europe and United States. I am evaluating all the proposals. When I signed in the NBA, I thought that my name would be forgotten, but this is not the case. I have never had so many offers as this season”

Ettore Messina on Mitch Kupchak, Jun 11, 2012. Source: Sportando.
